name: Forge Rat
description:
You spent a lot of time hanging around the public forges of Highlake, and you've picked up a flair for experimentation.

Once per Intermezzo, if you have access to a forge, you may spend at least one day modifying a weapon or piece of armor you own, choosing one of the following effects:

  • The item grants +1 Defense.

  • One of the item's damage dice increases by 1 die type.

  • One of the item's engagement dice increases or decreases by 1 die type.

Roll Craft to set the Difficulty. Whenever you're targeted by an attack roll that is against your Defense, if the roll result is greater than or equal to the Difficulty, your modified item is broken.

If after five such tests the item has not broken, the modification becomes permanent and you may use this ability to modify another item, or the same item a second time (but not a third time).

Describe your modifications.
